function.name: get_current_weather
function.description: Retrieves the current weather conditions for a specified location, providing temperature and atmospheric measurements. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which to get the weather, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA'.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for temperature values.

function.description: Add or create a new MTNA Rich Data Services (RDS) server configuration to the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The server name or nickname used to identify the RDS server within the system.

host.description: The server hostname or IP address where the RDS server is reachable.

api_key.description: The API key used for authentication with the RDS server. Keep this key confidential.

function.name: add_postgres_server
function.description: Add or create a new PostgreSQL server configuration to the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

nickname.description: The server name or nickname. Used to identify the server in the system.

host.description: The server hostname or IP address where the PostgreSQL server is running.

port.description: The port number on which the PostgreSQL server is listening.

database.description: The default database name to connect to on the PostgreSQL server.

username.description: The username for authentication with the PostgreSQL server.

password.description: The password for authentication with the PostgreSQL server.

function.description: Provide help, assistance, and guidance on a specified topic to the user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

topic.description: The topic for which help is being requested, such as 'email setup', 'software installation', 'account recovery', etc.

urgency.description: The urgency level for the help request.

include_resources.description: Flag to indicate if additional resources like links to guides or tutorials should be included in the help response.
